Verification

Every stage below must pass before this school earns the Superschool Verified badge — the trust mark shown to parents on the public school page.

AI ConfirmationConfirmed
Before this school could be claimed, our AI cross-checked its name, address and registration number against public records and map data, and confirmed it is a real, matching school.
2
Document Verification
Open the school's uploaded documents to review them against official records, then approve this step. Documents are uploaded and managed under School Profile.
3
Photo Verification
Upload the school's verification photos — any clear, current photos of the campus and facilities. Upload at least 1 photo (JPG or PNG, 50 KB–20 MB each, up to 15000×15000 px), then approve the set. Uploaded a wrong one? Hover a photo and hit the × to remove it.
4
Field Visit
A Superschools agent visits the school in person to confirm safety, infrastructure and that the listing matches reality.
5
Superschool Verified Badge
A Super Admin grants the Superschool Verified badge once the checks above are satisfactory. Once granted, it appears on the school's public detail page so parents know it has been independently checked.
How the badge appears on the public school page
